title: Functorial total-limit realization of coefficient-system reindexing laws
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, applying the functorial coefficient-system total limit to the system identities of PodSystemReindexingLaws l E g yields the evaluation, transpose, ambient beta and counit identities collected in PodSystemReindexedRealization l E g.

proof.text: Let h be podReindexingSystemHomReductionSquare_laws. For the evaluation, transpose, beta and counit fields, respectively apply congrArg ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map) to h.evaluation, h.compatible.transpose, h.beta and h.adjunction.counit. These are exactly the displayed realized equations, so no equality detection by finite evaluations or beta invertibility is used.
